svg.title: Card fraud platform: system architecture
svg.desc: Deployable units of Layer 1 and Layer 2 and the data between them, numbered per flow.
svg.text: System architecture: deployable units and the data they exchange
s3://lakehouse: bronze · silver · gold · feat_* · ml (training sets, ground truth) s3://core-banking-export s3://mlflow (model artifacts)
table catalog for Spark and Trino
end user: every card authorization, real time
daily, Airflow: DP1 -> DP2 -> DP3 -> Feast materialize
ML engineer: notebook, pipeline run, model image
continuous drift API + daily drift DAG
Arrow = data moving from A to B, labelled with the data; a call without data (B1, M7) still points from caller to callee.
Dashed boxes: support services used by many units (arrows left out).
Feast is a library, not a unit: it runs inside Scoring API, push jobs, Airflow, Jupyter and KFP steps.
